name: Oxfam in Uganda paper on taxing high-net-worth individuals (2023) and Francis Odokorach
detail: Calls for better compliance and enforcement on the income and property of wealthy individuals (the URA high-net-worth unit), not for a tax on net wealth.

name: Fair Tax Monitor Uganda (2018 and 2021 reports; Oxfam, SEATINI, Tax Justice Network Africa)
detail: The reports define "wealth taxes" as property, land and capital gains taxes and recommend strengthening those; they do not call for a tax on net wealth.

name: Lawrence Bategeka (MP, Hoima Municipality, 2017)
detail: Said taxing the rich is a good proposal that is hard to enforce and that properties should be taxed directly; that is a property tax, not a wealth tax.

name: Capital gains tax on non-business assets (Income Tax (Amendment) Bill, 2026)
detail: A withholding tax on gains from disposal of non-business assets is a tax on realised gains, not on the stock of wealth. Parliament's committee report on the bill discusses it.
source_url: https://bills.parliament.ug/attachments/FPED3-26-Report on the Income Tax (Amendment) Bill, 2026 (Including Minority Report).pdf

name: Afrobarometer, February 2026: 77% say it is fair to tax rich people at a higher rate
detail: Asks about higher rates for the rich, not about a wealth tax, so it is not entered as a poll.
